specific_semantic_reuse_gaps.US-DX-03: Adoption-plan tests do not prove immutable reviewed diagnosis baseline, baseline comparison or current-authority rules for this story.

specific_semantic_reuse_gaps.US-CM-05: Daily advisory limits are not authoritative budget-ledger usage or independent alerts; source requires the actual governed usage contract.
specific_semantic_reuse_gaps.FR-ACC-003: Native tenant-fence tests do not establish own-access capability/grant-path explanations for every source path.
specific_semantic_reuse_gaps.VF-DIN-001: Calculation-method file presence is not all golden corpus gate assertions or refusal of release on a failure; inspect the actual independent oracle/gate evidence.
